# Xipher documentation

> Guides and examples for Xipher: the CLI, web app, Go library, WebAssembly module, GitHub Action, credential-provider protocol, and Xipher KMS (XKMS).

The full documentation is one Markdown file: **https://xipher.org/docs.md**. This index covers the same content, scoped to `/docs/`. The HTML rendering is https://xipher.org/docs/ (identical content, same section anchors).

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://xipher.org/docs.md#introduction): What Xipher is and the forms it ships in.
- [Core concepts](https://xipher.org/docs.md#concepts): `XSK_`, `XPK_`, `XCT_` and where keys come from.
- [Quick start](https://xipher.org/docs.md#quickstart): First encryption in under a minute.
